_meta.description: D6 fixtures for cloudflare-agents / a2ui-recovery (A2UI error recovery)
_meta._note: The A2uiRecovery agent owns generate_a2ui (src/agent/a2ui.ts): it runs the render_a2ui sub-agent and the @ag-ui/a2ui-toolkit validate->retry loop. The Worker sends x-aimock-context on every model call (outer and inner), so every fixture here is context-scoped; the pill prompts are also unique to this integration (d5-a2ui-recovery.ts PROMPTS). Outer emits generate_a2ui with no-arg {}. HEAL: seq 0 invalid -> retry -> seq 1 valid -> paints. EXHAUST: invalid every attempt -> exhausts. Mirrors langgraph-python/a2ui-recovery.json.
